Yeah, absolutely. I can get that up for you. Do you have an order number?
Yeah, it's P58476.
Yeah, can I just confirm your name?
Is Jane Williams? Do you need my postcode?
Yes, that would be great. And your full address as well, if that's possible.
It's 38 Greenacre Drive CF3280U.
Perfect. I can see that on here. Okay, brilliant.
So I can see that you made your purchase and it is in our system.
I think there may be a problem with the card used.
Or did you use a Clana or a similar Binau Pay later skin?

essentially our plumber.

we would have heard of this issue many times.
